cards.name: Ashling the Pilgrim
cards.oracleText: {1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on Ashling. If this is the third time this ability has resolved this turn, remove all +1/+1 counters from Ashling, and it deals that much damage to each creature and each player.

cards.name: Ashling, Flame Dancer
cards.oracleText:
You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end.
Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, discard a card, then draw a card. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, Ashling deals 2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control. If it's the third time, add {R}{R}{R}{R}.

cards.name: Ashling, the Extinguisher
cards.oracleText: Whenever Ashling deals combat damage to a player, choose target creature that player controls. The player sacrifices that creature.
